entries.en: You download the evidence from Lorik's computer.
Quarantine lab locked down.
Fuel lines fixed.
Mira offline.
Landlines repaired.
This door can only be opened by Anoleis' assistant.
Synthetic Insights lockdown. Authorization Kaira Stirling.
Elevator locked down by order of Captain J. Ventralis.
Reactor power restored.
Not enough power for restart.
Memory bypass successful.
Electronic locks offline. Please consult station Virtual Intelligence.
Connection ports out of sequence. Unable to dock data module.
Memory Core 1 damaged. Transfer module stack to Core 2 or 3 to reactivate. Press Escape to Exit.
This elevator is only accessible to Binary Helix employees.
Elevator locked down until purge activated.
Emergency exit only.
Purge armed.
Authorization Required.
Maintenance door locked. Authorization required.
Hotlabs not accessible.
Synthetic Insights security disabled.
Repairs incomplete.
Core reactivated
What sort of offer did they make you?
Good. I don't think I'm supposed to mention numbers. They'd only write them down on thinstrip.
Full benefits, of course.
Oh, sure. "The company takes care of its own." Full insurance, paid vacations, subsidized housing. After a year, I'd start getting stock options.
You hear about the resort they've got here? At the equator? Bouncebacking, diving, an accredited asajura field...
If you like that sort of thing. I'd rather admire the view.
What do you think about the security? All the weapon detectors, the guards...
Yeah. Did you see the turrets on the way in?
The what?
Turrets. Outside. Big anti-ship weapons. Looks like they could fight off an orbital assault. A small one.
Yeah, but all the monitoring, cameras, and guards. It feels oppressive.
Really? With all the problems out here - pirates and whatnot? This might be one of the safest planets in the Traverse.
What have you heard about Peak 15?
That it's one of the lab complexes. And it's out of contact, or something.
Seems strange. The whole mountain going dark like that? People are pretty wound up about it. Not that they're saying much.
I heard someone say that they do secret weapons research up there.
Ah, people say that about every place they're not allowed to go. "It's got some big dark secret." How 'bout that lobster?
Pretty good. Almost tastes like the real thing. Texture's a little off, though.
You know what I noticed about this place?
What's that?
People don't talk. Listen. There's like a dozen people in here. You hear anyone but us?
There's that salarian on his comm.
But normally in a place like this, you'd hear--I don't know--I guess "the buzz of conversation?"
No one can talk about what they did at work. Not without getting sued, anyway.
Just seems kind of creepy.
You think you'll take the job?
I'm considering it.
So, uh, if you do, you think we might be able to meet sometime? You know. For coffee?
Coffee? Aw, that's quaint.
Or dinner. A vid. I don't know.
You're here for Elanus, right?
Yeah, I work in superconductors.
I'm here for Binary Helix. We wouldn't see each other a lot...
...unless we both worked on Peak 15.
Yeah, well, it was nice meeting you.
Yeah.
Don't hang up. Elder Brother? It's me. I'm on Noveria now.
I can't talk long. This call is costing 10 credits a minute. It's realtime from the Traverse. Did you think that would be cheap?
I need some information. There's an issue here. With Synthetic Insights.
The manager, Lorik Qui'in. He got caught with his toes wet. The office is closed by Hanshan's administrator.
I need you to see what you can find out about--Are you ready for his name?--Rannadril Ghan Swa Fulsoom Karaten Narr Eadi Bel Anoleis.
No, that's the administrator. The Hanshan administrator. Well, think about it.
A turian wouldn't risk getting his office closed. They don't compromise their "team." That's drilled into them from boot camp.
I think the administrator is using this Qui'in fellow to draw flies from his own clutch.
Of course I could look it up myself! But do you think I'm likely to get any unfiltered data through Noveria's own network?
That, and it would take forever for any out-system search results to get back here.
Thank you, Elder Brother. I have to go. Yes. I'll speak to you soon.
Don't hang up. Is Luhara Chu Niafahl present? Hello Nia. It's Rulamin. Yes. I'm on Noveria. A job interview with Synthetic Insights.
Instructional. I'd swear that every corporation has a former STG operator as their head of Personnel Resources.
It's the quietest place I've visited off homeworld. Everything is built with a good view, and there are constables everywhere. Very secure.
After I get done here, could we meet? It's been years since we heard each other with our real ears.
You're still on Ryskos? Right. I'll do some research tonight and see when I can get a packet there.
I'm looking forward to seeing you, too. I'll be in contact as soon as I have plans.
No. No, they're all on the secure server. Right off the root. Search for fiscals - projections - 2704 - latest. Yes. Right there.
Well, I don't know what to tell you. Maybe Laeta deleted them when she moved into my office.
Listen, I'm on an interview right now. Noveria. Yes.
Well, thanks. Too bad Stoma didn't realize that before he passed me up for promotion. Yes. Good luck with the fiscals.
Don't hang up. Ms. Ellison? It's Rulamin. Well, when I arrived, I found Synthetic Insights had been closed.
A criminal conduct investigation. I want you to keep looking for new positions.
No. I don't care how the investigation ends. I won't risk my reputation working for a suspect office.
All right. When you have some hits, flash them to my VI. He'll collate them for me. Thank you.
No, I don't hold this against you. You've done well for me in the past. I'm just-- It's been a long trip for nothing.
My trip may be extended. While I'm out here, I have some personal business to see to. We'll speak again.
Don't hang up. Ah? That's how salarians greet another over comm channels. Oh, since before we had spaceflight.
I think the idea was that you're disturbing the silence. So you want to assure the listener it's important. Look, I'm not an anthropologist. Do you mind?
That's all right. I need a packet flight from any groundside port on Noveria to Ryskos. Tomorrow. Really? None at all?
Can I assume that's due to security concerns? All right. Six days is the best you can do? Right, that makes sense.
All right, I'll see what I can do here. Thanks for your time.
Shakni! Wish I'd thought of this sooner.
...I listen. Apalon? It's been a few weeks, hasn't it? How are things at the office?
Everyone who came back from Peak 15 is being reassigned offworld.
Binary Helix's stock is taking a nosedive. Some big project went belly-up.
I can't believe the administrator is dead. There aren't supposed to be any guns on Noveria.
Synthetic Insights is open again. I wonder what the closure was about?
Since the administrator was arrested, our managers are interrogating everyone who talked to you.
You're the Spectre, right? Management told us not to talk to you.
They say there hasn't been an accident on Peak 15, but everyone knows.
Something weird is going on at the Synthetic Insights office. The administrator shut them down.
Peak 15 has bio- and cyber-hazard labs. If there is a problem, they should nuke it before it spreads.
I'd ask you out for coffee, but I have to work late tonight. And I might get fired for talking to you. And the coffee here sucks.
I'd love to have your job. Traveling the galaxy, saving lives - that's what I wanted to do as a kid. How'd that turn into accounting?
I'm sorry. The hotel is off-limits to those without a corporate account.
I can't let you in. You're welcome to enjoy a drink at our café.
We limit access to protect the privacy of our customers.
Chilly today. They should put some mirrors in orbit. Focus some sun down here to warm it up.
I told you to go the hell away.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. Parasini, Noveria Internal Affairs.
How can I help you?
One moment, please. Mr. Anoleis?
Yes. What? What!
Commander Shepard is asking to see you, sir.
Right, fine. Come in.
We're aware of the rumors. At the moment, contact with the facility is down due to weather.
Mr. Anoleis isn't the only one with a pass to leave Hanshan.
Qui'in spends his days at the hotel since his office was closed.
Very well.
Weapons detectors. Don't mind the alarms.
I am Gianna Parasini, assistant to Administrator Anoleis. We apologize for the incident in the docking bay.
One of my duties is orientation of new arrivals. Do you have any questions?
The Executive Board does everything in its power to protect the privacy of our client corporations.
This planet is beyond the jurisdiction of the Citadel. The law is what the Executive Board says it is.
Do you know how valuable this planet is? How many advances in genetics and artificial intelligence got their start here?
Tread lightly. The Board can bury you in litigation. You'd need an asari lawyer to see the case through.
Unusual? An asari Matriarch passed through a few days ago. Lady Benezia.
His office is on the main level. Left at the top of the elevator.
Of course. If you need any help, you can ask me at the administrator's office.
You're welcome. You understand our security chief was only doing her job.
She takes her job seriously. She is a valuable asset to the company.
I'd like to speak to Anoleis.
Tell me about the companies that work on Noveria.
I hear there was an accident on Peak 15.
You said I should talk to Lorik Qui'in.
Nothing right now, thank you.
Pretty heavy security for such a small port.
I can't have my investigation hampered.
Is this "privacy" intended to hide illegal research?
Has anyone unusual passed through here recently?
Where can I find the administrator?
Understood. Can we go in now?
I appreciate your help.
Someone piss in your security chief's coffee today?
I have urgent business here.
Spectre. Have you given any more consideration to my offer?
The Executive Board knows about Anoleis' corruption. I've been undercover for six months.
I want you to convince Qui'in to testify before the Board. With his evidence, this planet can run profitably again.
I'm Anoleis' secretary. You think he'd believe me? That he'd meet me in some dark alley with his evidence?
He's a crook, not a moron. He doesn't keep logs on his computer saying, "This month I stole three million credits."
Qui'in's testimony and records are everything I need to prove Anoleis' guilt in one package.
You help my investigation, I'll provide whatever you need. Favor for a favor.
Before the weather closed in, Hanshan received a Code Omega signal from them.
Code Omega means a terminal breach of safety protocols. No one goes up until the crew sends an all-clear.
That's all I've got. No one knows what's going on up there.
Something to do with Peak 15. She arrived after we received their Code Omega -- automated warning of a containment breach.
She came with an escort of asari commandos. They took the last shuttle up to Peak 15 with a load of crates.
The shuttles are down, so you'd have to drive up. If you get Qui'in to testify, I'll get you into the garage.
Thank you. You know where I work. Come talk to me once you know if he'll play ball.
I can produce a copy of Anoleis' pass for you. I can't move large sums of money without someone noticing.
If you have any love for the law, you'll talk to Qui'in for me. Don't disappoint me.
Yes, yes. Fate of billions and all that. I couldn't possibly understand how important your work is.
Act natural. You want to blow my cover?
You're meeting a beautiful woman for drinks. Smile and laugh. Pretend we're flirting.
We're two friends who haven't seen each other since college. Remember that time so-and-so did that thing? Ha ha!
Over two hundred fifty high-tech firms rent our labs. Major shareholders include Elanus Risk Control Services, Binary Helix, and Synthetic Insights, Ltd.
The Executive Board gets a discount on facilities security. Elanus also develops lethal and non-lethal weapons.
BH is a leader in genetics and biotechnology. They try to keep a low profile in the media.
Much of their research is in biotic modifications. That angers many Luddite, organic-baseline, and fundamentalist groups.
They're one of only four corporations licensed by the Citadel Council to develop artificial intelligence.
They attract many protests. No agitators have ever breached our security. That's why they invest heavily here.
Not at all, Spectre. This is my job, after all.
All employees should review their non-disclosure agreements, and avoid irresponsible free talk.
Binary Helix has leased the entire complex.
A blizzard is sweeping the Skadi Mountains right now. Between the cloud cover and heavy snow, the satellite uplinks are cut.
"Loose lips sink third quarter profits."
You have a more blunt way of speaking than is common here, Commander.
We have seventeen research complexes built into the mountains. Each is a self-sufficient facility housing a staff of hundreds.
What do you want?
Why don't you ask Qui'in directly?
You work for Anoleis. Can't you just take his records?
I need Qui'in's garage pass to complete my mission.
You gave me the company line about Peak 15. What's the truth?
What's happening up on Peak 15?
That doesn't tell me much.
Do you know why the Matriarch is here?
How can I get to Peak 15?
All right. I'll talk to Qui'in and see if I can convince him.
I'll keep Qui'in's evidence.
Qui'in is offering to pay me. Can you?
I'll consider it and get back to you.
If your Executive Board loses a few million credits, it's not my problem. I have my own mission.
Why is an Internal Affairs agent here?
I don't have time for pleasantries.
Your guards work for ERCS, don't they?
Binary Helix? They work in genetics?
Haven't I seen Synthetic Insights in the news lately?
I've taken up enough of your time.
What corporations work on Peak 15?
What kind of weather cuts modern communications?
So, "everyone shut up and keep your heads down?"
How large are the facilities here?
Well, you sure proved me wrong. My lack of faith in Spectres was entirely unjustified.
Well, pardon me all to hell for expecting you to do your job!
It's hard to be patient this close to the end. I can't wait to work in real clothes again. You have any idea how much I hate skirts?
Anoleis is dirty. It might be best to help her.
Seems we'd help more people if we did as she asks.
In the long run, it is better to remove the source of the problem.
Your call, Commander, but I say we help.
Lorik is offering a lot of money. A pass can open one door. Credits can open many.
Where have you been? Have you made any progress with Qui'in?
I'm going to close my eyes and count to ten. If I don't explode, tell me if you've convinced Qui'in to turn over his evidence and testify. One... fourteen...
Do you still have Qui'in's evidence? Will he testify?
You what? [sigh] I should have known. Spectres always do whatever the hell they want.
So you got what you need. Do you still have Qui'in's evidence? Will you talk to him for me? I can still present the evidence to the Board.
[sigh] That's a world of stress off my back. I'll take the evidence for safe transport.
I didn't think you'd help me. Being a Spectre and all. I guess some of you can be all right.
Uh, not so fast, hero. You need to get into the garage, don't you? To head up to Peak 15?
I'm ecstatic. But right now, I just feel like a long day of work is ending.
While you were working on Qui'in, I got you a garage pass. Be careful up there.
I have an arrest to make. Wish I had time to change into something easy to move in. I hate skirts.
Sorry. I'm used to having my guard up. When people find out I'm Internal Affairs, they treat me like a traitor.
This was the best opportunity I've had in-- Why did you sell it?
That's a real good excuse. You've got the job, you should do it right.
You're kidding. Do you have any-- WHAT THE HELL WERE YOU THINKING!
I would have helped you, too. It might have taken longer, but is that a reason to let a guilty man walk?
I shouldn't have expected any better from a Spectre. You never give a damn about anything beyond your assignment.
Oh, right. Qui'in's evidence. Forgot all about it.
I got what I needed in my own way.
I need to get to Peak 15. The shortest route was a straight line.
I needed to get to Peak 15. The shortest route was a straight line.
Language, miss.
Frankly, your self-righteous attitude pissed me off.
I need more time. Be patient.
You're too late. I already gave Qui'in his evidence.
You're too late. I already gave Anoleis the evidence.
I gave Qui'in his evidence a while back.
I gave Anoleis the evidence some time ago.
I used the evidence to "persuade" Anoleis to let me go to Peak 15.
I'll ask him. Be patient a little longer.
It took some persuasion, but Qui'in has agreed to testify.
I'll leave you to your work.
Doesn't this help you? You don't seem particularly happy.
So how about getting me into the garage?
That's some gratitude you've got there.
I decided to take Qui'in's reward. Sorry.
I never signed up to be a Spectre. I was drafted.
Anoleis paid me for it. Tough luck.
Oh, yeah, that.
The situation is resolved.
Anoleis has the evidence.
Goodbye.
Then our business is done.
I thought you'd be happier.
What about the garage?
Yeah, you're welcome.
I never asked to be a Spectre.
I need to get to Peak 15.
I needed to get to Peak 15.
No need to yell.
I don't like you.
What do you want?
Why are you here?
I don't have time for this.
Qui'in has the evidence.
Anoleis has the evidence.
You can't do this yourself?
Your job
I need Qui'in's pass.
Like I care?
I'll help you.
No, I won't help you.
Pay me.
I'll consider it.
Peak 15 accident
Peak 15 accident
Matriarch Benezia
Reach Peak 15
That's all you know?
Where's Anoleis?
Lorik Qui'in
Goodbye.
Corporations
Peak 15
Lab facilities
Elanus Risk Control
Binary Helix
Synthetic Insights
Goodbye.
Who has offices on Peak 15?
Weather? You're joking.
You're ignoring the problem.
Thanks for getting us through.
Yeah, real friendly.
We're in a hurry.
Why so many guards?
I heard there were geth here.
Goodbye.
I may have to step on toes.
Sounds suspicious.
Where's Anoleis?
I gave Qui'in his evidence.
I gave Anoleis the evidence.
I blackmailed Anoleis.
Give me time.
I convinced Qui'in.
I gave the evidence to Qui'in.
Benezia--? She is here?
Benezia left for the Peak 15 research complex days ago. To the best of my knowledge, she's still there.
You'll need to ask Administrator Anoleis for clearance to leave this port.
The Board doesn't like having outside problems dumped in its lap, Commander.
Saren's aide is here?
Saren's second-in-command. She's here?
Saren's right hand? She's here?
Saren's flunky? Where?
"Passed through?" Where is she now?
That's where I need to be, then.
Could you tell me how to get there?
Good. Give us directions, and we'll be on our way.
Can I speak with her?
She's a threat to galactic peace. I'm here to bring her in or put her down.
She left?
I need to talk to her.
She's a dead woman.
Then I'm going there.
I'll need directions.
I'll require your cooperation.
No idea. The commandos wouldn't let anyone near them. They seemed heavy, though.
The rule is "don't rock the boat." Self-interest is tolerated if it doesn't interfere with business. Anoleis is driving customers away.
Do you know what she had in the crates?
I thought corruption was the rule on Noveria.
Corruption
What was in the crates?
The Executive Board votes whether or not to destroy the facility. One antimatter warhead from the battlestations vaporizes all contaminants.
You know where I work. Come talk to me when you change your mind.
That's gratifying to hear.
I don't believe this. You've ruined a--
And if the crew never sends an all-clear?
I'm not here to dig out any corporate secrets.
What if there's no all-clear?
I'm not here for them.
Look, Shepard. I don't like this either. You Spectres play fast and loose with the law. That's bad for business.
While I'm young, Shepard.
Son of a bitch! This is what I get for entrusting it to a Spectre. What'd you do -- hold a gun to his head and order him to do it? God.
Get out of here. I need to see if I can salvage anything from this. I do not want to spend another six months wearing this outfit.
Pff. You know what? Forget it. I should have known better. Spectres never care about anything beyond their mission.
You underestimated Noveria's code of silence. Qui'in wouldn't rock the boat, no matter what assurance I offered.
He wouldn't testify.
Hurry it up already.
I've got a lot of work to do.
Fly off and cause problems for someone else.
She is here. I can't believe it.
Commander? Maybe we should tell Liara that her mother's here. Or bring her along. Maybe she can reason with Benezia.
Commander? Maybe we ought to tell Liara that her mom's here. Or bring her along. It might take Benezia off-guard.
Commander, it might be wise to bring Dr. T'Soni along. She knows her mother better than any of us.
If Lady Benezia is here, it might be wise to bring Liara along. She knows her mother better than we do.
All right.  I'll talk to Qui'in and see if I can convince him.
I'll help you.
You've never worked in the corporate world, have you, Commander? You can't bludgeon through bureaucracy.
Talk to Lorik Qui'in. You should be able to find him at the hotel bar.
Can't say more. Not within earshot of Mr. Anoleis.
So it would seem. I need an alternative.
I can bludgeon pretty hard.
All right. What would you do?
I can see that.
Don't underestimate me.
What do you suggest?
I'd like to help you, Miss Parasini, but I need Qui'in's garage pass. It's vital to my mission.
I have my own mission.
I'll talk to him.
Get off my back.
I don't think Qui'in will agree to testify. Can't you just take the evidence?
I doubt Qui'in will help.
Thank you. You know where I work. Come talk to me once you know if he'll play ball.
I needed to get to Peak 15.
I need to get to Peak 15.
I blackmailed Anoleis.
I gave Qui'in his evidence.
I gave Anoleis the evidence.
Talk to you later.
Goodbye.
I don't have time for this.
I have a mission to complete.
I'm a little busy now.
You gave my package to the administrator.
Next time, ask whose property you're giving away.
I'm not stupid. I have nothing to gain by attacking you at this point.
I don't blame you. I'd have done the same.
Opold and I, though-- We're going to have a long talk.
Do that.
You've got something of mine. It's past time you handed that package over.
Good. Go.
You think I'm stupid? There are guards right over there.
Hrr. That so? We'll see.
Do that.
What do you want?
Like I care that you know? You his courier or something?
Hrr. Sit down a minute. I have a business proposal.
I'm paying the hanar more than I want. I'll bet he's paying you less than you want. Sell it to me directly.
Five hundred credits.
Hrr. Kids these days, they don't know what a good weapon is worth.
I'll give you 750.
Likewise.
Now go away. The guards wonder about people who trade packages for cash.
Hrr. I could snap your neck before you pull a weapon. But I like your negotiation skills. Reminds me of my father.
Glad you know a deal when you hear it. Opold will have to go back to selling gum and cigarettes.
Probably couldn't add up how much more you'd earn.
Hrr. You know him so well that he's earned your loyalty?
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Make the right decision.
I could be the King of Space. Beat it.
Whatever.
Human blood. With cinnamon. Find someone else to bother.
Hmph.
Beat it.
I said, beat it.
Go find something else to do. Stupid mammal.
If you don't stop poking me, I'll throw you off that balcony.
I didn't ask who Opold was selling to.
So? You going to do something about it?
I had my own business to take care of. Your package was a means to an end.
Right. I'll just leave you alone, then.
I was just about to drop it off.
Tough talk. Care to back it up with action?
What's it worth to you?
Too bad. I've decided I want it for myself.
I'll take care of it before I leave.
I've heard Opold has something for you.
I was on my way to deliver it.
Interesting. But exactly how much is this worth to you?
You and I are both professionals. You know this is worth more than that.
Deal. Pleasure doing business with you.
If you want to see more of the package than me beating you with it, make a serious offer.
I'll take it.
Not good enough. I'll take it to Opold.
Sorry. I told him I'd do this for him.
I'll consider your offer.
No, but I could be.
I'll leave you to your drink.
What's that you're drinking?
Nothing. Sorry to bother you.
I got my package. Now go away before the guards catch us talking.
You have my package?
Then go get it.
Yes, but I haven't picked up his cargo yet.
Not yet.
That was yours?
Sorry.
What are you having?
Goodbye.
Yes.
I will be.
Not yet.
Goodbye.
Give me a figure.
No.
Maybe.
This is worth more.
Be serious.
I'm in.
No deal.
Agreed.
Tough.
Goodbye.
I'm on my way to Opold.
Make me.
Let's make a deal.
I'm keeping it.
I will.
No.
To talk about Opold.
I'll get back to you.
Hmph. Stupid base-ten math. That's what they get for having extra fingers.
I've got no more business with you.
Just walk away slowly and act natural.
Let's make a deal.
An intriguing offer. Perhaps you'll see me again soon.
I am. I thought it would be better to deal with you directly.
I don't like your tone.
Let's talk.
Sounds good.
Not enough.
Not enough.
Spectre. How good of you to return.
My office will open again soon enough. In the meantime, is there anything I can do for you here?
I believe we've already discussed our differences of opinion.
Always a pleasure, Spectre. Any news on that matter I asked you to look into?
Back again? What can this old turian do for you today?
Afternoon. Sit down, have a drink. What can I do for you?
You are the Spectre that just arrived, are you not? What could an old turian like me possibly help you with?
Your picture has been sent to every employee. They have been warned that speaking to you is grounds for termination.
It is too late for cover-ups, Commander.
Lorik Qui'in. For the moment, I am the manager of the Synthetic Insights office.
Mr. Anoleis closed my office. He claims to be investigating reports of my corruption.
Put bluntly, the administrator demands rent kickbacks from the companies on Noveria.
You mean my loitering here? If only it were mere indolence.
There have been unseemly rumors circulating, along the lines of "ancient evil" and "plague from distant suns."
Hmph. Amusing, no? Someone watches too many bad horror vids.
Your manner may be too blunt for Noveria. This is a place of subtlety.
Yes, she caused quite a stir. It is not every day a Matriarch arrives with a guard detail of commandos.
She claimed to be Saren's assistant, here to get a certain project "back on track." I suspect she meant Peak 15.
They rarely venture beyond asari space. To see such an esteemed figure is surprising.
Lady Benezia was also dressed for her role. An asari in a pinstriped suit set tongues wagging among the younger male employees. So to speak.
Young males have an unhealthy obsession with my species.
Young men have funny ideas of what asari are like. I blame the extranet. And computer games.
I don't know if they were disarmed. Of course, one can't confiscate biotic powers.
Saren--and by extension, Benezia--is an important person. By that I mean an investor who might sell stock if denied.
Humans are full of questions. I should write a book about it while I have the time to spare.
Indeed? That might be difficult. A terrible storm has been unleashed up there.
Of course. What else would I be referring to?
Not surprising. Of course, all the managers have access as well. I do, for that matter.
"Let me go?" Do humans consider conversation a form of imprisonment? That would explain why so few are willing to sit and talk...
The job is done.
Not yet.
Not yet.
I finished the job. But an Internal Affairs investigator contacted me. She wants you to testify against Anoleis.
Anoleis has your evidence now.
Are you Lorik Qui'in? I've heard you might be able to help me.
What makes you think I'm a Spectre?
I'm Commander Shepard of the Systems Alliance Navy.
Who might you be?
Having some trouble with your office?
"For the moment?"
Taking a three-martini lunch?
Did you see an asari Matriarch recently?
Do you know why Benezia is here?
Is it so unusual to see a Matriarch?
